question: Which sages are positioned on the right side of the deity?
premises: Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha, and Bhṛgu are named.
Their location is specified as the right side.
inference: Nārada, Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha, and Bhṛgu are placed on the right side.
plain_english: Nārada, Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha, and Bhṛgu are on the right side.
